why: filing words as the person's own, one note or every note the page shows, and saying a note is not what they said: each door lets the person through, then asks whether the grant carries the press, and otherwise refuses as before
background: The secretary card keeps all three doors, so an office whose person changed nothing behaves as before. A press under the grant writes the secretary's own note, or the secretary's mark, each naming the secretary, the grant and the press. A note filed under the grant is never the person's own words, so a decision in their name cannot cite it as theirs.
